metadata.title: Valinor Agency | Custom Web Design & Development
metadata.description: We build websites, online stores, applications, and dashboards for companies, professionals, and entrepreneurs.
metadata.ogImageAlt: Valinor Agency — Custom Web Design & Development

nav.whatsappMessage: Hi! I came from the Valinor website and I'd like to ask about a development project.

footer.tagline: We design and build clear, useful web solutions tailored to each business.

hero.whatsappMessage: Hi! I came from the Valinor website, I have a project I'd like to develop
hero.experience: Over 8 years of experience designing and building digital solutions.

projects.name: Websites and landing pages
projects.purpose: Present your company, brand, or product with a clear, professional experience, or communicate a specific offer focused on capturing inquiries.
projects.capabilities: Interface design, content architecture, basic technical SEO, and contact forms.

projects.name: Online stores
projects.purpose: Sell products or services with your own catalog, an optimized checkout, and a panel to manage orders and stock.
projects.capabilities: Catalog architecture, payment integrations, and order management panels.

projects.name: Web applications
projects.purpose: Solve specific business workflows, like bookings, portals, or sales tracking, with a custom-built tool.
projects.capabilities: User flow design, authentication, integrations, and admin panels.

projects.name: Dashboards and data visualization
projects.purpose: Bring together key metrics, statuses, and alerts in a clear view to make decisions with up-to-date information.
projects.capabilities: Data visualization, configurable alerts, and integration with different data sources.

projects.name: Management systems
projects.purpose: Organize documents, processes, or internal information that today lives scattered across spreadsheets or folders.
projects.capabilities: Data organization, role-based access control, and status tracking.

projects.name: Integrations
projects.purpose: Connect existing tools and automate specific tasks to reduce repetitive manual work.
projects.capabilities: Connecting APIs and external services, and automating processes according to each project's needs.

techStack.heading: Current technology. Human judgment.
techStack.paragraph: Our team brings together specialists in product, design, frontend, and backend. We choose top-tier tools for each challenge and use artificial intelligence to speed up analysis, development, and quality control.

capabilities.label: Digital experiences
capabilities.title: Fast, clear interfaces designed to convert.

capabilities.label: Solid systems
capabilities.title: Architectures built to grow and stay maintainable.

capabilities.label: Custom integrations
capabilities.title: We connect tools and automate specific tasks whenever a project needs it.

browserMock.heroCopy: We design clear experiences for brands ready to move forward.

scrollLines.ariaLabel: Digital solutions built around your goals

whyUs.heading: What changes when you work with us.
whyUs.ariaLabel: What sets our way of working apart

reasons.title: Visible deliverables
reasons.desc: We split the project into reviewable milestones to validate decisions before the final delivery.

reasons.title: Technology with judgment
reasons.desc: We choose the technical foundation based on the goal, the budget, and how the team operates.

reasons.title: Direct contact
reasons.desc: You talk to the people designing and building. Fewer intermediaries, less lost context.

reasons.title: Transparent scope
reasons.desc: We agree on deliverables and terms before starting. If something changes, we assess it clearly.

reasons.title: Observable results
reasons.desc: We define what should improve so we can review the outcome with evidence, not promises.

milton.name: Milton Collard
milton.bio: Specializes in frontend development, interface design, SEO, and conversion optimization. Combines functional analysis and development to turn business goals into clear, effective experiences.

martin.name: Martín Abbott
martin.bio: Specializes in backend development, databases, and integrations. Combines functional analysis and technical judgment to build solid, maintainable solutions aligned with business needs.

finalCTA.paragraph: It could be a site to present your business, an online store, or a tool to organize processes. We review the goal and propose a clear scope.
